name: LOLA data ingest, coordinate conversion, and topography geometry verification
purpose: Verify label-driven D01 decoding, longitude/latitude conversion, interpolation, and triangulated geometry.
configuration: D01 LDEM_4 IMG/LBL; no smoothing or undocumented resampling; strict generic application: moon input receipt with explicit two-stage radial AMR, explicitly disabled full-volume AMR Tecplot output, frozen environment, solid-angle shell weighting, projected-Sun limb branches, selectable D14-backed sky coordinates, 120 s exposure, and unresolved radial beam response.
independent_reference: Four native IMG samples decoded independently before the test was run, plus icosphere topology identities and outward-orientation invariants.
units: degrees and metres relative to the label-defined reference sphere
frame_time_convention: Label-defined lunar body-fixed coordinates; longitude convention explicit.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Deterministic decoder and control-point selection fixed before comparison.
procedure: Parse the primary custom-profile application: moon block through the shared generic AMPS parser, reject the retired #section spelling, verify the exact adjustable AMR/environment fields including disabled full-volume Tecplot output, comparison-grid endpoints, and declared observation-geometry scalars/selectors; reject an invalid environment mode, mesh-output Boolean, and profile label; parse a second receipt selecting the other D14-backed coordinate/display choices and one projected-Sun limb branch; verify native label metadata and byte count; decode four fixed native pixel centres; generate a 500 km icosphere; apply DEM radii; check topology/edge uniformity/orientation; and parse the CEA and surface-Tecplot outputs. The input checks are parser invariants and do not qualify U26.
metrics: radial AMR endpoint, mesh-output switch, and frozen-environment retention
declared SZA/shell-weighting/limb/tail selector and scalar retention
acceptance_criteria: The generic application: moon spelling is accepted and the retired #section spelling is rejected; exactly 81 comparison-grid points with 0, 200, 1000 and 10000 km boundaries and exact retention of the custom profile, declared disabled full-volume Tecplot switch, SZA, solid-angle shell weighting, projected-Sun limb branch, J2000 RA/Dec, west-right display, 120 s exposure-average, unresolved beam-response, and tail scalar controls; invalid mesh-output, profile, or environment selectors must be rejected; a second receipt must retain away-from-projected-sun, ECLIPJ2000 lon/lat, and east-right without changing the primary object; exact label dimensions, reference radius, and four native pixel-centre elevations; 642 vertices and 1280 faces; maximum great-circle edge <=500000 m; minimum/maximum chord ratio >=0.75; every face outward; CEA record counts exact; surface-Tecplot FETRIANGLE header present.
expected_pass_result: A reproducible D01 geometry product is numerically correct.
status_semantics: PASS requires both the production-kernel criteria and a parseable canonical D01 package whose qa_report.json and provenance.json declare D01 READY and whose two immutable raw files match the frozen hashes. This local PASS does not satisfy linked I14.
skip_reason: D01 is absent or its package metadata explicitly does not declare the dataset READY.
missing_capability: Linked I14 production-wiring and convergence verification remains separate from U08.
